main.description: A community's operational settings. Separate from the profile record so the two have different read audiences.

categoryOrder.description: The order categories are displayed in.

requiresApprovalToJoin.description: Whether joining produces an application a moderator must approve.

linkEmbeds.description: Whether link previews are shown by default. Channels may override this.

labelers.description: DIDs whose labels this community honours, in addition to the community's own. Empty means the community labels its content itself.
